listing.descriptionMarkdown:
## LightMem-Ego
Capture the glasses camera and microphone to build a searchable timeline of daily events. Ask questions by voice or from the companion web UI, and read memory-grounded answers with timestamps on the Rokid HUD.

**Backend required:** The app needs a reachable LightMem-Ego server. The published APK is preconfigured to upload captured frames and audio to the authors' hosted demo at `https://lightmem-ego.zjukg.cn/api`. To use your own server, change `API_BASE_URL` in `LightMemEgoConfig.kt` and rebuild from source before recording. Do not start a capture session with private content unless you accept the configured destination.

A phone is not required. See the upstream README for the Docker backend, model/API credentials, and glasses controls.
